command:
set -eu
base=/srv/legacy2/atomic-release-publication
log=/tmp/atomic-reader.$$.log
(
    i=0
    while [ "$i" -lt 3000 ]; do
        [ -L "$base/current" ] || { printf 'missing current at iteration %s\n' "$i"; exit 1; }
        resolved=$(readlink -f "$base/current") || { printf 'unresolvable current at iteration %s\n' "$i"; exit 1; }
        case $resolved in
            "$base/releases/one"|"$base/releases/two") ;;
            *) printf 'unexpected target %s at iteration %s\n' "$resolved" "$i"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        [ -f "$resolved/MANIFEST" ] || { printf 'missing manifest at iteration %s\n' "$i"; exit 1; }
        [ -f "$resolved/index.txt" ] || { printf 'missing data at iteration %s\n' "$i"; exit 1; }
        manifest=$(cat "$resolved/MANIFEST")
        data=$(cat "$resolved/index.txt")
        case "$manifest|$data" in
            'release=one|Complete release one.'|'release=two|Complete release two.') ;;
            *) printf 'mixed or partial release at iteration %s: %s|%s\n' "$i" "$manifest" "$data"; exit 1 ;;
        esac
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    printf 'reader_checks=%s missing=0 partial=0 mixed=0\n' "$i"
) > "$log" 2>&1 &
reader=$!
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 500 ]; do
    if [ $((i % 2)) -eq 0 ]; then
        "$base/bin/publish" releases/one
    else
        "$base/bin/publish" releases/two
    fi
    i=$((i + 1))
done
wait "$reader"
cat "$log"
rm -f -- "$log"
"$base/bin/publish" releases/two
printf 'publication_swaps=%s\nfinal_target=%s\nfinal_manifest=%s\nfinal_data=%s\n' "$i" "$(readlink -f "$base/current")" "$(cat "$base/current/MANIFEST")" "$(cat "$base/current/index.txt")"
